Sect: Sabbat

A renegade cult that broke from the Followers of Set, the Serpents of the Light claim origins in the West Indies rather than Egypt, distancing themselves from their parent clan's traditions. Early Serpents found protection from their hostile forebears within the Sabbat, and lasting animosity between the two groups grew until the Serpents declared total independence. They practice manipulation through seduction, exploiting a target's vice - drugs, sex, power, or otherwise - to bring them under control, generally working through minions and from the shadows.

Disciplines: Obfuscate, Presence, Serpentis

Advantage: Like their parent clan, the Serpents thrive in the underworld and vice markets their unlives depend upon; each gains one extra Streetwise Ability at no additional cost, plus one Influence (Political, Street, or Underworld) at no extra cost during character creation.

Disadvantage: Despite their name, Serpents of the Light remain creatures of the night and are unusually sensitive to light. Sunlight exposure inflicts an additional health level of damage, and other bright light sources (spotlights, flares, halogen streetlights) impose a one-Trait penalty on all actions performed under them.

Organization: Serpents of the Light operate through networks of dupes and minions, rarely revealing themselves directly, and maintain a bitter rivalry with the Followers of Set wherever the two cross paths.
